skills.name: Recuperative Treatise
skills.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff4414|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

skills.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
skills.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7788|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3622|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

skills.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
skills.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3530|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff9878|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Blinding Flare
skills.description:
Launch a blinding flare, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies in the target area for |cffffff5|r seconds. Exposed enemies are stunned for |cffffff4|r seconds, and cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds.

While slotted you gain Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

skills.name: Proximity Detonation
skills.description:
Activate a magical bomb on yourself that explodes after |cffffff8|r seconds, dealing |cffffff1804|r Magic Damage to all enemies in the area.

Each enemy within the bomb's radius increases the damage by |cffffff100|r%, including the original target.
